data.name: HeroSubtitle
data.value: The evolution of a platform: how we replaced line-by-line typing with the surgical direction of artificial intelligence.

data.name: SparkDesc
data.value: Phase 1-2. Building the 'heart' of the platform—safe code execution via Roslyn and Docker orchestration.

data.name: LanguageDesc
data.value: Phase 3. Teaching the platform to speak globally. A fully bilingual, real-time localized architecture.

data.name: AestheticDesc
data.value: Phase 4-5. The rebranding evolution from generic developer UI to the modern, glass-morphic 'Dusk' identity.

data.name: FortressDesc
data.value: Phases 6-10. Securing the perimeter and preserving the legacy. Integrating Keycloak IAM and strict EF Core persistence.

data.name: AbyssDesc
data.value: The architecture eventually collapsed under its own generated complexity. The AI components were logically sound in isolation but tore each other apart in a distributed environment: user sessions vanished in infinite loops, and the database locked up from simultaneous overwrites. The solution wasn't to write more manual code ourselves. We mapped the underlying logical failures and designed highly surgical, Socratic prompts—forcing the AI to interrogate its own flaws and piece the system back together securely.

data.name: MentorDesc
data.value: Phases 11-15. Injecting intelligence. Integrating the Socratic Gemini Tutor API natively into the student workflow.

data.name: VibeManifesto
data.value: We don't code; we build intent.
